message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout that left the whole neighborhood in the dark. I was that gloriously over-prepared person, with my flashlights and power banks all charged up. While my neighbors were scrambling for candles, I was confidently lighting up the living room with my lantern and enjoying a movie night with the kids on our portable screen. It felt good to be ready, even if I did get a few chuckles for my ‘emergency stash’. Sometimes, being a little too prepared can turn a nuisance into a cozy family adventure!
